boss_summary: The corrected resolution closes all eight design errata from the prior HOLD sufficiently to guide new draft implementation and adversarial tests. It defines an acyclic artifact graph with an external trust root; separates stable pre-restart expectations from ephemeral post-restart lease state; puts every authority-bearing final check before one terminal completed transition and treats post-completed drift as unknown; specifies correct WAIT_TIMEOUT process-liveness semantics and fail-closed access uncertainty; requires NTFS link_count exactly one; separates read-only zero-delta evidence from synthetic transaction evidence; places every discretionary review before restart and permits only pre-frozen synchronous checks inside the lease; and makes the absent external owner capability a permanent execution stop with no local fallback. This is a design pass only. No implementation, test, component freeze, execution freeze, live host state, human identity, owner capability, transaction, or publication result was inspected or qualified.

errata_closure.basis: The corrected graph orders code_lock, detached digest, independent reviews, reviewed_release_record, execution_freeze, and external capability without direct or transitive self-hashing. The external capability API is named as the first trust anchor and its current absence remains blocking.

Stable code, file, root, volume, executable, allowlist and pre-freeze boot fields are explicitly separated from live PID, process token, ancestry, handle, clock, nonce and registry state. Ephemeral identity is bound only prepare-to-publish in one lease.

All authority-bearing checks now precede one terminal completed transition. Post-completed drift is diagnostic unknown state and cannot authorize automatic forward writes, rollback, or rewriting completed as recovery_required.
errata_closure.implementation_invariant: The state label transaction_started may establish lock, journal and ownership only. It grants no canonical forward-write authority; validated_publish and all required live checks must precede the first forward replacement.

errata_closure.basis: Running means WaitForSingleObject(process_handle, 0) equals WAIT_TIMEOUT with unchanged PID, creation token and executable identity. Access denial, partial enumeration, exit, PID ambiguity, inaccessible bounded rows and unclassified ancestry are explicit hard blocks; unavailable test coverage is never PASS.

The rule is categorical and exception-free: every target and sentinel requires a supported NTFS link-count observation equal to one at freeze and each live transition; an extra or unmeasurable link blocks.

Read-only collection has its own zero-byte/member-delta receipt and metadata/hydration disclosures. Synthetic disposable-fixture transactions have separate exact intended-delta and zero-out-of-scope-change receipts and cannot be called canonical execution.

Every discretionary design, implementation, test, kernel, primitive, wrapper, checker, premortem and boss review is pre-restart. Only pre-frozen deterministic same-process functions may execute during the lease, and expiry closes the lease without publication.

The missing product/runtime owner capability is permanently recorded as absent and blocks execution-freeze issuance, canonical measurement, restart request, OneDrive action, prepare, publish and recovery. Local JSON, CLI, workspace files, environment variables, model tokens and asserted booleans are forbidden substitutes.
